display_information.name: BugBot
display_information.description: Guided bug intake and triage for Roarington QA
display_information.long_description: BugBot turns a Slack message into a properly structured Jira bug. /bug opens a form that requires the fields QA actually needs (app, environment, device, OS, browser, viewport, input method, steps, expected vs actual, severity, frequency), files the issue in Jira, and keeps the reporter informed as it moves through triage. It complements the official Jira Cloud for Slack app rather than replacing it.

slash_commands.description: Report a bug with the guided QA form
Show the status of bugs you reported
List bugs awaiting triage, with routing buttons (QA only)
Weekly bug intake and triage summary

shortcuts.name: Report as bug
shortcuts.description: Open the bug form prefilled from this message
